lines.speaker: host
lines.text: You try the obvious defence. That is not all mine.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Fine. Split it between every person alive.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Your share is more than three thousand dollars. An hour.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Thirty *million* dollars a year, delivered to you, for free, since the day you were born.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Then you look at your real bills. Electricity. Fuel. Food.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Coal is sunlight that plants caught hundreds of millions of years ago.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Wind is air the Sun warmed. Rain is water the Sun lifted.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Your dinner is this summer's light.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: You have almost never paid for energy.
